integrity: Exact formula proved by classification of projected subspaces, central intersections, and graph lifts; small prime-field exhaustive direct bracket tests corroborate it.
scientific_limitations: Distinctly labeled star graphs only; ideal counts are finite-field linear ideals, not all subalgebras or normal subgroups. Large-field limit fixes n>=4; independent priority and mathematical audit not performed. Computational checks use small prime fields.
title: Ideal-dimension enumeration and large-field concentration for star-graph Lie algebras
